# pve_vm_snapshot (Data Source)

Reads a single QEMU VM snapshot (`GET /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_vm_snapshot" "pre_upgrade" {
  node = "pve1"
  vmid = 100
  name = "snap1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The snapshot identifier (upstream `snapname`).
- `node` (String) The cluster node running the VM.
- `vmid` (Number) The VM identifier. Must be between 100 and 999999999.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The snapshot description or comment.
- `parent` (String) The parent snapshot identifier, if the snapshot participates in a snapshot tree.
- `snaptime` (Number) The snapshot creation time as a Unix epoch in seconds.
- `vmstate` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot includes the VM RAM state.
